document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

    /* 1️⃣ Fix missing label for inputs */
    document.querySelectorAll("input, textarea, select").forEach(function(el) {
        if (!el.hasAttribute("aria-label") && !el.hasAttribute("aria-labelledby")) {
            let placeholder = el.getAttribute("placeholder");
            let name = el.getAttribute("name");

            if (placeholder) {
                el.setAttribute("aria-label", placeholder);
            } else if (name) {
                el.setAttribute("aria-label", name.replace(/[_-]/g, " "));
            } else {
                el.setAttribute("aria-label", "Form field");
            }
        }
    });

    /* 2️⃣ Fix empty links & buttons */
    document.querySelectorAll("a, button").forEach(function(el) {
        if (!el.textContent.trim() && !el.getAttribute("aria-label")) {
            el.setAttribute("aria-label", "Clickable element");
        }
    });

    /* 3️⃣ Fix role errors */
    document.querySelectorAll("[role]").forEach(function(el) {
        const invalidRoles = ["presentation", "none"];
        if (invalidRoles.includes(el.getAttribute("role")) && el.hasAttribute("aria-label")) {
            el.removeAttribute("aria-label");
        }
    });

});

.free_MC {
  display: inline-block;
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 17px;
  color: #ff0000;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.free_MC span {
  display: inline-block;
  transform: skewX(-10deg);
  animation: letterFlash 1s infinite;
}

/* Stagger delay (har letter alag timing pe) */
.free_MC span:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0s; }
.free_MC span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
.free_MC span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
.free_MC span:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.3s; }

@keyframes letterFlash {
  0% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: skewX(-10deg) scale(1);
  }

			<script>
			document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

    const counters = document.querySelectorAll(".trust-number_d");

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries, observer) => {

        entries.forEach(entry => {

            if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;

            const counter = entry.target;
            const target = parseInt(counter.dataset.target);
            const suffix = counter.dataset.suffix || "";

            let start = 0;
            const duration = 2000;
            const startTime = performance.now();

            function update(currentTime) {

                const progress = Math.min((currentTime - startTime) / duration, 1);

                const value = Math.floor(progress * target);

                counter.textContent = value + suffix;

                if (progress < 1) {
                    requestAnimationFrame(update);
                } else {
                    counter.textContent = target + suffix;
                }
            }

            requestAnimationFrame(update);

            observer.unobserve(counter);

        });

    }, {
        threshold: 0.5
    });

    counters.forEach(counter => observer.observe(counter));

});</script>

<script>
	
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
	const nav = document.querySelector("nav[id^='bellows-main']");
	if (!nav) return;

	const originalUL = nav.querySelector("ul[id^='menu-']");
	if (!originalUL) return;

	const menuID = originalUL.id;
	const items = Array.from(originalUL.children);
	const mid = Math.ceil(items.length / 2);

	// Create two ULs with same dynamic ID and class
	const col1 = document.createElement("ul");
	const col2 = document.createElement("ul");

	col1.id = menuID;
	col2.id = menuID;

	col1.classList.add("menu-col","bellows-nav");
	col2.classList.add("menu-col","bellows-nav");

	// Distribute li items
	items.forEach((item, index) => {
		const clone = item.cloneNode(true);
		(index < mid ? col1 : col2).appendChild(clone);
	});

	// Replace original UL with two columns
	originalUL.remove();
	nav.appendChild(col1);
	nav.appendChild(col2);
});


</script>

<script>
  function toggleContrast() {
    document.body.classList.toggle('high-contrast');
  }
  let currentFontScale = 1;
  const originalFontSizes = new Map();

  function changeFontSize(factor) {
    const elements = document.querySelectorAll('body, body *');

    if (factor === 0) {
      // Reset to original font sizes
      elements.forEach(el => {
        if (originalFontSizes.has(el)) {
          el.style.fontSize = originalFontSizes.get(el);
        } else {
          el.style.fontSize = '';
        }
      });
      currentFontScale = 1;
      return;
    }

    elements.forEach(el => {
      const computedStyle = window.getComputedStyle(el);
      const currentSize = parseFloat(computedStyle.fontSize);

      // Save original font size if not already saved
      if (!originalFontSizes.has(el)) {
        originalFontSizes.set(el, computedStyle.fontSize);
      }

      const newSize = currentSize + factor * 1.5;
      el.style.fontSize = newSize + 'px';
    });

    currentFontScale += factor * 0.1;
  }
</script>

<script>


$(document).ready(function () {
	var maxMobileSize = 768; // this value should match the media query
	var mobileAccordionTableSelector = ".table.mobile-accordion";


	// Resize and Reorientation code borrowed and modified from this StackOverflow answer:
	//		http://stackoverflow.com/a/6603537
	var previousOrientation = window.orientation;

	var checkOrientation = function() {
	    if(window.orientation !== previousOrientation){
	        previousOrientation = window.orientation;
	        checkScreenSize();
	    }
	};

	var checkScreenSize = function() {
		var width = $(window).width();

		if (width < maxMobileSize) {
			handleMobile();
		} else {
			handleDesktop();
		}
	}

	window.addEventListener("resize", checkScreenSize, false);
	window.addEventListener("orientationchange", checkOrientation, false);

	// Android doesn't always fire orientationChange on 180 degree turns
	setInterval(checkOrientation, 2000);


	function handleMobile() {
		slideUpAllInactive();
	}

	function handleDesktop() {
		showRows();
		addRowHighlighting();
	}

	function showRows() {
		$(mobileAccordionTableSelector + " .tr").each(function () {
			$(this).removeAttr("style");
		});
	}

	function addRowHighlighting() {
		var rows = $(".table .tbody .tr");
			
		/* Add a highlighting class on even rows */
		for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
			if (i % 2 == 1) {
				$(rows[i]).addClass("alternate-highlight");
			}
		}
	}

	function slideUpAllInactive() {
		$(".table .rh").not(".active").each(function() {
			$(this).next().slideUp();
		});
	}

	function handleMobileAccordionTableClick(rowHeader) {
		var table = $(rowHeader).parents(".table");

		$(table).find(".rh").each(function () {
			$(this).removeClass("active");
		});

		slideUpAllInactive();

		var nextRow = $(rowHeader).next();
		if (!nextRow.is(":visible")) {
			$(rowHeader).addClass("active");
			nextRow.slideDown();
		}
	}

	$(mobileAccordionTableSelector + " .rh").click(function () {
		handleMobileAccordionTableClick(this);
	});

	// Need to run this on first load
	checkScreenSize();
});

</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const headers = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".inner-table-responsive thead th")).map(th => th.textContent.trim());
  const rows = document.querySelectorAll(".inner-table-responsive tbody tr");

  // Assign data-label to each cell
  rows.forEach(row => {
    row.querySelectorAll("td").forEach((td, i) => {
      td.setAttribute("data-label", headers[i]);
    });
  });

  // Accordion click behavior
  rows.forEach((row, index) => {
    row.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (this.classList.contains("active")) {
        this.classList.remove("active");
        return;
      }
      rows.forEach(r => r.classList.remove("active"));
      this.classList.add("active");
    });
  });

  // Keep first row open on load
  if (rows.length > 0) {
    rows[0].classList.add("active");
  }
});
</script>

<script>
(function () {

  /* ===============================
     1. LIMIT FONT SCALING (+ / -)
  =============================== */
  document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {

    const info = document.querySelector(".onetap-info");
    if (!info) return;

    let percent = parseInt(info.innerText);

    if (percent >= 30 && e.target.closest(".onetap-btn-increase")) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      return false;
    }

    if (percent <= -30 && e.target.closest(".onetap-btn-decrease")) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      return false;
    }

  }, true);


  /* ===============================
     2. CLEAN FONT IN TARGET AREA
  =============================== */
  function cleanFonts() {

  document.querySelectorAll("p").forEach(p => {

    const parentSize = parseFloat(window.getComputedStyle(p).fontSize);
    if (!parentSize) return;

    p.querySelectorAll("em, span, a").forEach(el => {

      const original = parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-original-font-size"));

      if (original) {
        // Maintain ratio scaling
        const ratio = original / 16;
        const newSize = parentSize * ratio;
        el.style.setProperty("font-size", newSize + "px", "important");
      } else {
        // fallback → match parent
        el.style.setProperty("font-size", parentSize + "px", "important");
      }

      el.style.setProperty("line-height", "inherit", "important");

    });

  });

}



  /* ===============================
     3. FIX CARD TITLE CLIPPING
  =============================== */
  function fixCardTitle() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".card-titleb a").forEach(el => {
      el.style.setProperty("max-height", "none", "important");
      el.style.setProperty("min-height", "0", "important");
      el.style.setProperty("height", "auto", "important");
      el.style.setProperty("line-height", "1.4", "important");
    });
  }


  /* ===============================
     4. FORCE HERO VIDEO MUTE
  =============================== */
  function forceMuteVideo() {
    const video = document.querySelector(".playvideo");
    if (!video) return;

    video.muted = true;
    video.defaultMuted = true;
    video.volume = 0;

    video.addEventListener("play", function () {
      this.muted = true;
      this.volume = 0;
    });
  }


  /* ===============================
     5. FIX FONT SCALING LIMIT
  =============================== */
  function fixFontScaling() {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-original-font-size]').forEach(el => {

      let original = parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-original-font-size'));
      let current = parseFloat(el.style.fontSize);

      if (!original || !current) return;

      let min = original * 0.8;
      let max = original * 1.3;

      if (current < min) {
        el.style.setProperty('font-size', min + 'px', 'important');
      }

      if (current > max) {
        el.style.setProperty('font-size', max + 'px', 'important');
      }

    });
  }


  /* ===============================
     6. OVERLAY TEXT RESPONSIVE
  =============================== */
  function adjustOverlayText() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.card-img-overlay .BG_title a').forEach(el => {

      let parent = el.closest('.card-img-overlay');
      if (!parent) return;

      let width = parent.offsetWidth;
      let size = width / 18;

      size = Math.max(14, Math.min(22, size));

      el.style.setProperty('font-size', size + 'px', 'important');
      el.style.lineHeight = '1.2';
      el.style.textAlign = 'center';
    });
  }


  /* ===============================
     7. ONE GLOBAL OBSERVER (FIX)
  =============================== */
 let ticking = false;

const globalObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
  if (!ticking) {
    ticking = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      cleanFonts();
      fixCardTitle();
      fixFontScaling();
      adjustOverlayText();
      ticking = false;
    });
  }
});

  globalObserver.observe(document.body, {
    subtree: true,
    attributes: true,
    attributeFilter: ['style', 'class']
  });


  /* ===============================
     8. INITIAL RUN
  =============================== */
  window.addEventListener("load", function () {

  function runFix() {
    cleanFonts();
    fixCardTitle();
    fixFontScaling();
    adjustOverlayText();
    forceMuteVideo();
  }

  // Run immediately
  runFix();

  // Run after plugin loads (IMPORTANT)
  setTimeout(runFix, 500);
  setTimeout(runFix, 1200);
  setTimeout(runFix, 2000);
  setTimeout(() => cleanFonts(), 2500);
setTimeout(() => cleanFonts(), 3500);

});


  /* ===============================
     9. HANDLE RESET CLICK
  =============================== */
  document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    if (e.target.closest(".onetap-reset-settings")) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        cleanFonts();
        forceMuteVideo();
      }, 300);
    }
  });

})();
</script>

  function protectInlineText() {

    subtree: true,
    attributes: true,
    attributeFilter: ['style']
  });

})();

<script>
(function () {

  function removeStrongIfHasSup() {

    document.querySelectorAll('strong').forEach(strong => {

      if (strong.querySelector('sup')) {

        const parent = strong.parentNode;

        // Move all children (including <sup>) outside <strong>
        while (strong.firstChild) {
          parent.insertBefore(strong.firstChild, strong);
        }

        // Remove empty <strong>
        parent.removeChild(strong);
      }

    });

  }

  // Run on load
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", removeStrongIfHasSup);

  // Run after plugin or dynamic updates
  const observer = new MutationObserver(removeStrongIfHasSup);

  observer.observe(document.body, {
    subtree: true,
    childList: true
  });

})();
</script>

The National Institute of Securities Markets (NISM) is a public trust established in 2006 by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), the regulator of the securities markets in India. The institute carries out a wide range of capacity building activities at various levels aimed at enhancing the quality standards in securities markets.
